description: Wikipedia summary API, look up any topic on Wikipedia. The opening summary of a Wikipedia article for a topic (any language edition, default English): title, short description, summary text, image and link. Finds the best matching article if the title is not exact. Text is CC BY-SA 4.0: credit Wikipedia and link the article. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: wikipedia_summary
